description_en: Reruns a job to obtain the historical data of the job. You can call this operation only in the professional edition
description_zh: 重跑任务的历史数据，只有专业版才支持
kebab_example: aliyun schedulerx2 rerun-job --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace adcfc35d-e2fe-4fe9-bbaa-20e90ffc0000 --group-id testSchedulerx.defaultGroup --job-id 123 --start-date 1645459200000 --end-date 1645718400000 --data-time 10:00:00 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RerunJob

parameters.help_en: The namespace ID. You can obtain the namespace ID on the Namespace page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 命名空间ID，在控制台的命名空间页面中获取
parameters.name: namespace

parameters.help_en: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party
parameters.help_zh: 特殊第三方才需要填写
parameters.name: namespace_source

parameters.help_en: The application group ID. You can obtain the application group ID on the Application Management page in the SchedulerX console
parameters.help_zh: 应用分组ID，在控制台的应用管理页面中获取
parameters.name: group_id

parameters.help_en: The time when the job starts to rerun. Specify a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 开始日期时间戳，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: start_date

parameters.help_en: The time when the job stops running. Specify a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
parameters.help_zh: 结束日期时间戳，精确到毫秒
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.help_en: The data timestamp of the job. Specify a string in the HH:mm:ss format
parameters.help_zh: 数据时间字符串，格式为HH:mm:ss
parameters.name: data_time

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
API执行是否成功。取值如下：

true：成功。
false：失败
